At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

• Oversee medical monitoring of clinical trials, including engagement with site investigators and external medical monitors.

We are building new money. Not crypto.

The Digital Assets team at Nubank is reimagining how a bank can use blockchain technology to solve real problems for real people - without ever making customers think about the blockchain at all. We have deliberately renamed ourselves from Crypto to Digital Assets, and we have effectively banned the word "crypto" internally. We do not do crypto for crypto's sake. We do blockchain banking.

The reference point is Apple Pay. It runs on cryptography, public and private keys, and secure tokenization inside a secure enclave. Apple never says any of that. It says "on device," and it just works. That is the standard for everything we ship.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer (IC8/IC9) to join the Digital Assets team in Palo Alto. You will be the lead design voice for a genuinely new category: making digital assets - Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, stablecoins, and tokenized equities - as simple, accessible, and trusted as a debit card swipe.

This role sits at the intersection of consumer product design, financial innovation, and zero-to-one invention. Much of what you will design has never existed in consumer form before. You will not be asked to study what the incumbents did; the explicit instruction is to carve a new path.

WHAT YOU WILL DESIGN

* The buy, hold, and sell experience for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and USDC - designed to feel as intuitive as buying a song, not as complicated as opening a brokerage account.

* Stablecoin-powered remittances: a customer sends $100 to Brazil and it just works, with no visible notion of what moves it underneath.

* Tokenized equities: one-to-one representations of real-world assets like Apple or Tesla stock, simplified for everyday investors.

* The invisible infrastructure layer that powers core banking functionality across the entire company, including the US build.

* Both the customer experience and the platform that other teams will draw on for future launches.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* Consumer instincts over crypto fluency. Deep domain experience in crypto is not the point here - and can even work against you. If your instinct is to explain custody models or gas fees to a customer, this is not the seat.

* Mobile expertise is a must-have. There is no desktop app in Brazil; effectively no web. Strong recent mobile work is non-negotiable, and a primarily B2B or enterprise background is a hard fit.

* Zero-to-one experience. You have designed products that did not exist before, where there were no references to copy, and you thrived in the ambiguity.

* A product marketing mindset. You care about the words, the positioning, and how it feels - not just the design elements. Our touchstone is "a thousand songs in your pocket," decided before the product was designed.

* The ability to hide complexity. You have made something complicated feel obvious and delightful. Products that resonate with us: Cash App, Apple, the Tesla app, Duolingo, Wise, Revolut.

This role develops and implements architecture patterns, engineering standards, automation solutions, and reusable platform capabilities that improve developer experience, accelerate delivery, and increase platform reliability, security, and scalability. AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Software Systems Engineer to join our Software Development Team. This role focuses on the design, development, verification, and sustainment of system software across flight, ground, and testing domains, while also supporting the coordination of daily software activities and aligning priorities across Ground Software, Flight Software, and Systems Testing teams.

The ideal candidate brings a solid foundation in systems engineering and software practices, along with strong collaboration skills to contribute to successful program execution.  

Key Responsibilities:

• Define system architectures and interfaces across software components.

• Review and refine requirements to ensure they are complete and testable.

• Monitor system performance budgets (e.g., timing, memory, power) throughout development.

• Plan and execute verification activities to validate system performance.

• Support integration, testing, and debugging of hardware and software.

• Contribute to development milestones and gate reviews.

• Apply configuration management and maintain system documentation.

• Develop interface and data flow documentation.

• Coordinate daily software team activities and priorities.

• Track, triage, and escalate software issues as needed.

• Facilitate team meetings and drive action items to closure.

• Maintain accurate documentation across shared engineering tools.

Qualifications  

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience:

• Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in software systems engineering, development, or verification.  

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working with complex or distributed systems, such as aerospace, telecommunications, or embedded platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to create and maintain technical documentation using collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, SharePoint, or similar platforms).

• Experience working within Agile development environments and familiarity with CI/CD practices.

• Exposure to communications systems, networking technologies, or other high-reliability system domains is a plus.

• Familiarity with model-based systems engineering (MBSE) concepts and industry standards is beneficial.  

Soft Skills:

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to escalate issues appropriately.

• Collaborative, proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and adapt to new technical domains.

• Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a positive team environment.  

Technology Stack:

• Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., C/C++ for embedded systems, Python for automation and testing).

• Experience with issue tracking and version control tools (e.g., Jira, Git).

• Understanding of configuration management principles and software development lifecycle processes.

Physical Requirements  

• Ability to work in a standard office or engineering lab environment.

• Ability to use a computer and related equipment for extended periods.

• Participate in virtual or in‑person meetings as required

• High School diploma/GED

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree

description:

• Collaborate with the team to define and document software engineering processes and practices, ensuring adherence to quality standards and regulatory requirements

• Extremely organized and detail-oriented, and excellent verbal & written communication skills

• A sincere commitment to a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture

• Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance

• Ability to travel domestically up to 25% as needed for test planning and execution, and excitement to work onsite at our headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA the rest of the time!

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Hands-on experience with prototyping, troubleshooting, and building complex robotic systems

• Experience with mission systems to include communications systems and components

• Familiarity with aviation airworthiness considerations
